donor_reference_conditions.pool: all non-padding utterances from the same dataset Training Split, including stored all-zero modality vectors
donor_reference_conditions.selection: one donor index sampled uniformly with replacement for each target validation utterance and repeat; no labels used
donor_reference_conditions.rng: numpy PCG64(first128bitsBigEndian(SHA256(canonicalJSON[dataset,dialogue_id,utterance_index,target,rho,repeat,donor]))); model seed is intentionally excluded so every model seed receives the same donor for the same validation target
donor_reference_conditions.text_all_alignment: the same donor dialogue and utterance supplies T1,T2,T3,T4
donor_reference_conditions.donor_missingness: save whether the selected donor modality is all zero and report Visual donor results for all donors and separately for visual-present versus visual-missing donors; do not post-hoc remove zero donors from the preregistered main donor pool
donor_reference_conditions.interpretation: distribution-reference sensitivity control, not an emotionally neutral replacement

text_arrays.meaning: four stored RoBERTa feature arrays in dataloader order; encoder-layer identities are not established

visual_missingness.definition: all 342 stored visual dimensions exactly zero
visual_missingness.handling: retain the sample and original visual input/probability; mark inactive for V mean and donor interventions; analyze visual_present and visual_missing separately

statistics.ci: paired percentile 95% on fixed OOF scores; logistic models are not refit inside bootstrap
statistics.seed_aggregation: report every model seed independently, sample mean and sample SD across five seeds, and direction consistency; do not pool duplicate validation utterances across model seeds

correctness_prediction.cross_validation: leave-one-dialogue-out independently within each dataset and model seed
correctness_prediction.standardization: fit on each training fold only
correctness_prediction.model: LogisticRegression L2 C=1 fixed, no hyperparameter search
correctness_prediction.donor_models: evaluated independently and never mixed with mean-reference primary features

historical_joint_diagnostics.anchor_only: join prior light perturbation observations only where historically available; do not fabricate missing Seed observations

decision_gate.A: cross-seed sensitivity ranking unstable: pause ranking-based Reliability Score
decision_gate.B: sensitivity stable but no correctness increment: study dependence/bias/class specificity
decision_gate.C: sensitivity stable and adds correctness information: eligible for separately preregistered calibration stage
decision_gate.D: only dataset/modality-specific evidence: use conditional rather than universal reliability design
